name: Softmax-GS
definition: A unified solution for 3D Gaussian Splatting that addresses view-inconsistency (popping effect) and diffuse boundaries by enforcing a softmax-based competition in overlapping regions between two Gaussians, allowing a continuous spectrum from smooth color blending to crisp boundaries.
summary: Softmax-GS is a 3D Gaussian Splatting method that resolves view-inconsistency by enforcing softmax-based competition among overlapping primitives to control boundary sharpness.
